# B310 Mobile + Neural Notes

## Neural
B296 remains the canonical executable plastic spiking substrate. B310 only changes executive arbitration and utility representation around it.

Verified regression: 5616 synaptic updates in B298; 8112 in B304; 4680 in B302.

## Mobile
B301 mobile state economy remains active. Latest observed compaction reduced 4,682,063 bytes to 4,294,017 bytes (8.29% saving).

B310 adds per-pulse B297 persistence. This is intentionally accepted because the B297 state is small compared with the large cognitive projections, and stale executive evidence is a correctness risk.

Real Android hardware is still required for final device readiness evidence.
